name: Chặng đường của mình
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame (the whole map on the table), one stop at each of the six places (PAUSE.inBeat into its beat, the pin in and its tag hung), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the ring box on the X), and the last frame. Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: tag0-n ... tag5-n are the places (label) and tag0-l ... tag5-l their lines (caption) on the luggage tags; names is the two names in the cartouche (label), spot the words under the X (caption), question the question on the paper strip (text). Alpha (the 5th number of each box) carries the scene's fades and the veil that darkens the map at the end. Compromises: the map, the route, the six places and their landmarks are the template's (the scene's demo), so a card changes only the words; the names and the words at the X are lettering on the map in the scene and are painted into boxes that follow the camera; a tag's words appear as the tag unfolds and do not swing with it; the question's strip lies level instead of tilted 2 degrees and its ink fades in instead of being written left to right. The map's own lettering (Bản đồ, Biển Nhớ, the scale) stays in the film. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
